      Privacy and Responsible Information Sharing Statement

      The Shire of Bruce Rock may collect personal information to respond to enquiries, provide services, process applications, communicate with you, and deliver our programs, facilities and community initiatives. The information collected may also be used to improve our services and engagement with the community.

      Your personal information will only be used or disclosed where it is necessary to carry out Shire functions, where you have provided consent, or where authorised or required by law. If requested information is not provided, the Shire may be unable to process your request or deliver the service you have sought.

      The Shire of Bruce Rock manages personal information in accordance with the Privacy and Responsible Information Sharing Act 2024 (WA) and its Privacy and Responsible Information Sharing Policy. You may contact the Shire to enquire about how your personal information is managed, or to request access to or correction of your personal information.

      Privacy and Responsible Information Sharing Statement

      The Shire of Bruce Rock may collect personal information to respond to enquiries, provide services, process applications, communicate with you, and deliver our programs, facilities and community initiatives. The information collected may also be used to improve our services and engagement with the community.

      Your personal information will only be used or disclosed where it is necessary to carry out Shire functions, where you have provided consent, or where authorised or required by law. If requested information is not provided, the Shire may be unable to process your request or deliver the service you have sought.

      The Shire of Bruce Rock manages personal information in accordance with the Privacy and Responsible Information Sharing Act 2024 (WA) and its Privacy and Responsible Information Sharing Policy. You may contact the Shire to enquire about how your personal information is managed, or to request access to or correction of your personal information.

      The Shire of Bruce Rock may collect personal information to respond to enquiries, provide services, process applications, communicate with you, and deliver our programs, facilities and community initiatives. The information collected may also be used to improve our services and engagement with the community.

      Your personal information will only be used or disclosed where it is necessary to carry out Shire functions, where you have provided consent, or where authorised or required by law. If requested information is not provided, the Shire may be unable to process your request or deliver the service you have sought.

      The Shire of Bruce Rock manages personal information in accordance with the Privacy and Responsible Information Sharing Act 2024 (WA) and its Privacy and Responsible Information Sharing Policy. You may contact the Shire to enquire about how your personal information is managed, or to request access to or correction of your personal information.

      Privacy and Responsible Information Sharing Statement

      The Shire of Bruce Rock may collect personal information to respond to enquiries, provide services, process applications, communicate with you, and deliver our programs, facilities and community initiatives. The information collected may also be used to improve our services and engagement with the community.

      Your personal information will only be used or disclosed where it is necessary to carry out Shire functions, where you have provided consent, or where authorised or required by law. If requested information is not provided, the Shire may be unable to process your request or deliver the service you have sought.

      The Shire of Bruce Rock manages personal information in accordance with the Privacy and Responsible Information Sharing Act 2024 (WA) and its Privacy and Responsible Information Sharing Policy. You may contact the Shire to enquire about how your personal information is managed, or to request access to or correction of your personal information.

      The Shire of Bruce Rock may collect personal information to respond to enquiries, provide services, process applications, communicate with you, and deliver our programs, facilities and community initiatives. The information collected may also be used to improve our services and engagement with the community.

      Your personal information will only be used or disclosed where it is necessary to carry out Shire functions, where you have provided consent, or where authorised or required by law. If requested information is not provided, the Shire may be unable to process your request or deliver the service you have sought.

      The Shire of Bruce Rock manages personal information in accordance with the Privacy and Responsible Information Sharing Act 2024 (WA) and its Privacy and Responsible Information Sharing Policy. You may contact the Shire to enquire about how your personal information is managed, or to request access to or correction of your personal information.

      Privacy and Responsible Information Sharing Statement

      The Shire of Bruce Rock may collect personal information to respond to enquiries, provide services, process applications, communicate with you, and deliver our programs, facilities and community initiatives. The information collected may also be used to improve our services and engagement with the community.

      Your personal information will only be used or disclosed where it is necessary to carry out Shire functions, where you have provided consent, or where authorised or required by law. If requested information is not provided, the Shire may be unable to process your request or deliver the service you have sought.

      The Shire of Bruce Rock manages personal information in accordance with the Privacy and Responsible Information Sharing Act 2024 (WA) and its Privacy and Responsible Information Sharing Policy. You may contact the Shire to enquire about how your personal information is managed, or to request access to or correction of your personal information.
